Setup requirements:
1. Create a Google Auth Platform project for package `com.codexfoundry.derpyowl`.
2. Register the debug or release SHA-1 and SHA-256 used by Android Studio or Gradle.
3. Paste the generated OAuth web client ID into `app/src/main/res/values/strings.xml` as `google_web_client_id`, or override it from a local Android resource file you do not commit.
4. Run on an Android device or Google APIs AVD with Google Play services.

Until then, use the native dev fallback button to keep local score persistence working.
